title: Schedule of Benefits for Homeowner Service Contracts: Systems, Plumbing and the Aggregate Term Limit
content:
**Per-term benefit limits — home systems and plumbing — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts.** Each figure is the per-term limit, in US dollars, for the item named in the row, on the tier named in the column. A limit of 0.00 means the item is not covered by that tier. The first row is the aggregate term limit: the maximum total benefit Bridgewell pays on the contract per term across all items and allowances.

| | ApplianceCare | SystemsCare | HomeCare Bronze | HomeCare Silver | HomeCare Gold | HomeCare Platinum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aggregate term limit | 8000.00 | 10000.00 | 12000.00 | 15000.00 | 20000.00 | 25000.00 |
| Heating system | 0.00 | 2500.00 | 1500.00 | 2500.00 | 3500.00 | 5000.00 |
| Cooling system | 0.00 | 2500.00 | 1500.00 | 2500.00 | 3500.00 | 5000.00 |
| Heating and cooling ductwork | 0.00 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 |
| Interior plumbing leaks and breaks | 0.00 | 1500.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 |
| Clearing interior drain stoppages | 0.00 | 500.00 | 300.00 | 500.00 | 750.00 | 1000.00 |
| Water heater | 0.00 | 1500.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 |
| Interior electrical system | 0.00 | 1500.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 |
| Ceiling fans | 0.00 | 300.00 | 0.00 | 300.00 | 400.00 | 500.00 |
| Garbage disposal | 0.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 | 400.00 | 500.00 |
| Whirlpool bathtub motor and pump | 0.00 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

- *Not covered* rows: Bridgewell ApplianceCare shows 0.00 on every row of this schedule other than the aggregate term limit, so none of these systems is covered on that tier. Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze shows 0.00 for ductwork, ceiling fans and the whirlpool bathtub; Bridgewell HomeCare Silver shows 0.00 for the whirlpool bathtub.
- A higher tier rank does not mean a higher limit on every row: Bridgewell SystemsCare carries 2500.00 for the heating system where Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze carries 1500.00.
- Example, hypothetical: on Bridgewell HomeCare Gold the water heater row reads 2000.00 and the aggregate row reads 20000.00; those are the two limits this schedule sets for a water heater on that tier.
